message.content: {"caption":"Two grouped bar charts compare accuracy across three iterations for Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B on math and general tasks.","description":"The target is a two-panel grouped bar chart. The left panel, titled “Math AVG,” has Accuracy on the y-axis, which runs from 50 to 60; the right panel, titled “General AVG,” has a y-axis running from 30 to 40. Both x-axes show Iter1, Iter2, and Iter3. The legend identifies green bars as Qwen3-4B and light-blue bars as Qwen3-8B. There are no value labels on the bars, so the values are estimated from their heights. In both panels, both models trend upward across the iterations, and Qwen3-8B is higher than Qwen3-4B at every iteration. In Math AVG, Qwen3-4B rises slightly from about 52.0 to 52.2 to 52.5, while Qwen3-8B rises from about 55.1 to 55.6 to 58.2, with its largest increase at Iter3.
